descriptive_pure_single_fault_ranking.scope: Descriptive argmax among five sigmoid family scores, conditioned on a known single fault. Excludes healthy and mixed cases; not a deployment decision rule or threshold tuning.

interpretation: Main results are conditional on the declared practical physical rules and paired noiseless raw distance>=5. They cannot be compared causally with V1performance on its old unfiltered distribution.

The paired V1comparison, when present, measures both frozen models on identical V2testwindows with separate1%healthy-reference calibrations. It does not identify which individual data/profile change caused improvement.
Boundary aggregate combines rejected-core positiveexamples and independently retained SFT-rangeHIF; only the explicit SFTchallenge stratum estimates its sampled20-200pu envelope.
Boundary examples are positive faults and have no healthy controls; no boundary healthyFPR or fault-absence certification is established.
Main/boundarywindows share independent testparents. Parent coverage cannot be added across cohorts.
Family scores are multilabel; own-family recall can coexist with wrong extraheadflags. Exact-family flags and extraheadrates are reported.
WLS generic alarms on measurement/parameter/topologyfaults are appropriate detections; reduced GNNphase triggers there indicate investigationselectivity, not measured total cost savings.
PhaseAonly input and paired-distance selection skew HIFphase representation; perphase and resistance-band results are supplied.
Allcalibration/selection remain frozen after test inspection. These are normalized fixed-PQ resistor/unbalance simulations, not field/arcing/harmonic or fullnodebreaker validation.

previous_v1_recalibrated.operating_point_note: Both frozen models use independently computed healthy-only1%reference thresholds on the same V2calibration parents; each realized testFPR is reported.
